description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing APIService resources in the Kubernetes API aggregation layer, including CRUD operations, watch, patch, and apply functionalities.

classes.name: APIServicesGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving APIService client interface.

classes.name: APIServiceInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods to manage APIService resources, including create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, and apply.

classes.name: aPIServices
classes.description: Implementation of APIServiceInterface, providing concrete methods to interact with APIService resources.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of an APIService.

methods.name: DeleteCollection
methods.description: Deletes a collection of APIService resources.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists APIService resources based on provided options.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches for changes to APIService resources.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to an APIService resource.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to an APIService.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the status of an APIService.

methods.name: newAPIServices
methods.description: Constructs a new aPIServices client instance.
